items.summary: Pokererotic.com lacks site-specific analytics, SEO, revenue, health, and public-surface evidence in the authoritative snapshot. Complete one bounded read-only baseline before proposing production work.

Select exactly one reversible implementation candidate or document the evidence-backed blocker. Do not deploy, add tracking, change credentials, spend, or infer traffic, revenue, conversions, or attribution.
